tools.name: timeneye_get_account
tools.description: Get the Timeneye account the token belongs to: name, trial and expiry dates, user limit and billing status. Good first call to check the connection. API: GET /account.

tools.name: timeneye_list_users
tools.description: List the members of the account, with status and group membership. Use it to find a user_id for other tools. API: GET /users.

tools.name: timeneye_list_clients
tools.description: List clients (customers) of the account. Use it to find a client_id for projects and entries. API: GET /clients.

tools.name: timeneye_get_client
tools.description: Get one client by id. API: GET /clients/{client}.

tools.name: timeneye_list_projects
tools.description: List projects, with client, billable flag, active state and budget fields. Use it to find a project_id for time entries. API: GET /projects.

tools.name: timeneye_get_project
tools.description: Get one project by id, including its team and budget. API: GET /projects/{project}.

tools.name: timeneye_list_phases
tools.description: List phases (tasks or stages inside a project). Time entries need a phase_id. API: GET /phases.

tools.name: timeneye_list_entries
tools.description: List time entries, filtered by date range, user, project, client, billing status or note text. Dates are yyyy-mm-dd. billed_status: 0 unbilled, 1 billed, 2 not billable, 3 billable. API: GET /entries.

tools.name: timeneye_get_entry
tools.description: Get one time entry by id, with minutes, notes, billing state and tags. API: GET /entries/{entry}.

tools.name: timeneye_list_allocations
tools.description: List planned allocations (hours planned per user and project over time). Dates are yyyy-mm-dd. API: GET /allocations.

tools.name: timeneye_list_time_off_requests
tools.description: List time-off requests the token can read, filtered by status and date range. scope 'can_see' is the default. API: GET /time-off-requests.

tools.name: timeneye_create_entry
tools.description: Log time on a project phase for a date. Writes a new time entry in the account: minutes, date, project_id and phase_id are required. API: POST /entries.
